column1: The dataset contains 1,200 simulated shipments with operational, transportation, traffic, weather and priority variables.
The average simulated delivery time is 19.26 days, while the median is 17.24 days.
Linear Regression produced the lowest RMSE among the three tested models in the fixed train/test split.
The selected model achieved MAE of 1.27 days, RMSE of 1.60 days and R² of 0.972.
Average delivery time varies by transport mode; Sea has the highest simulated average and Air the lowest.
Higher traffic and adverse weather conditions are associated with longer simulated delivery times.
Distance shows a positive relationship with delivery time, indicating that longer routes require greater time allowances.
The feature-importance analysis provides a basis for prioritizing operational variables during planning.
